mentions.name: Eigakan Guide ChatGPT plugin
mentions.description: A ChatGPT plugin in development that will allow users to search Japanese cinema showtimes (via Eigakan Guide) through ChatGPT using natural language queries.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently building a ChatGPT plugin which will allow searching showtimes through ChatGPT using natural language and later on I will add AI chat search features to the actual site as well.
